justification: Restructures GATE-1pt2's dwelling-form selection, which drives the capacity engine's dwelling yield. The old logic picked densest(permitted) as a single dev_type and over-reported (shop_top_housing is permitted-with-consent in low-density R2); its LGA join was also dead (all R3/R4 fell to dwelling_house). This replaces it with a RANGE: an as-of-right floor + a permitted ceiling bounded by the zone tier, so the engine lifts R3/R4 correctly yet structurally cannot over-report R2. Engine remains unexposed (#513 unmerged).

pre_impl.existing_data: lep_land_use_table (zone, lga, development_type, permissibility) holds 17,353 rows across 25 LGAs; permissibility in {permitted, prohibited, exempt}. ConstraintArithmeticResult already carried dev_type + realistic_dwellings. Verified read-only 2026-06-19 via the post-gate live sweep.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: GATE-1pt2 (#518) assumed densest(permitted) = realistic form and that _council_from_zone_epi's name matched lep_land_use_table.lga. Both were wrong: permitted-with-consent includes outlier dense forms (shop_top in R2), and the council name carries suffixes/None ('Canada Bay Council', None for Sutherland) that exact ILIKE never matched, so the join was dead and masked the over-report behind a dwelling_house under-report.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new data, no schema migration. New pure helpers select the form: zone tier (_ZONE_TIER_CEILING, structural R1-R5 metadata) caps the form, the LGA permitted set (matched via _norm_lga) filters it. compute_constraint_arithmetic gains an optional ceiling_dev_type and emits a range (as_of_right_* + max_permitted_*) off the same envelope. realistic_dwellings is unchanged (stays the conservative floor).
pre_impl.external_source_error: The zone + EPI come from the NSW Planning Portal. _permitted_engine_forms returns an empty set on missing inputs, no LGA coverage, or any DB error, and _realistic_forms then returns ('dwelling_house','dwelling_house') - the conservative baseline. It can never select a form denser than the zone tier, so a surprising permitted-use value cannot produce an over-report.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Backend only. Four new Optional fields on ConstraintArithmeticResult (as_of_right_form/dwellings, max_permitted_form/dwellings); existing fields keep their types. The capacity card (#513) is unexposed and is the next increment that renders the range.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: R3/R4 lots silently under-reported as 1 dwelling (dead join) and, had the join worked, R2 lots would have over-reported as shop_top/multi-unit. After: R3 lifts to its medium-density ceiling, R2 is capped at dual-occ, and the headline realistic_dwellings stays conservative. The ceiling is the upside SUBJECT TO a DA, never presented as achievable without one.

functions.name: _ceiling_within_tier
functions.input: zone code and the set of permitted engine forms for that zone+LGA
functions.output: the densest permitted form at or below the zone-tier ceiling
functions.if_none: no permitted form at/below the tier -> 'dwelling_house' (an outlier denser-than-tier permitted use is never selected)

functions.name: _realistic_forms
functions.input: zone code and LGA name (any naming variant)
functions.if_none: missing inputs / no LGA coverage / DB error -> ('dwelling_house','dwelling_house')

functions.name: compute_constraint_arithmetic
functions.input: lot area, dev_type (floor), optional ceiling_dev_type, LEP height/FSR, lot dims, DCP, SEPP
functions.output: result with realistic_dwellings (floor, unchanged) plus as_of_right_* and max_permitted_* off the same envelope
functions.if_none: ceiling_dev_type None -> max_permitted_* stay None; as_of_right_* still set from dev_type

values: N/A - no regulatory values hardcoded. _ZONE_TIER_CEILING maps a zone to its densest realistic FORM (Standard-Instrument R1-R5 density character, universal NSW, never amended per-LGA) and only ever caps the form downward; it is not an LEP control value. Actual GFA/FSR/height come from the portal and the envelope maths, unchanged.
queries: N/A - the only query is SELECT lga, development_type FROM lep_land_use_table WHERE zone = %s AND permissibility = 'permitted'; scoped by zone, parameterised, read-only, sub-second on 17k rows. LGA matched in Python via _norm_lga.

break_it.scenario: A low-density R2 lot where shop_top_housing is permitted with consent (Penrith/Sydney, the live-sweep finding)
break_it.what_happens: densest(permitted) would pick shop_top_housing and count the whole envelope as apartments - a gross over-report on a low-density lot
break_it.how: the R2 tier caps at dual_occupancy; walking the ladder from the tier down skips shop_top -> returns dual_occupancy. test_ceiling_within_tier + live 17 Corden Ave = max_permitted 2 (dual_occupancy)

break_it.scenario: An R3 lot where residential_flat_building happens to be permitted
break_it.what_happens: an RFB (apartment) yield would be reported on a medium-density street, over-reporting the realistic townhouse yield
break_it.how: R3 tier caps at multi_dwelling_housing; RFB is above the tier and skipped -> multi_dwelling_housing. test pins this

break_it.scenario: Council name arrives suffixed or as None (Canada Bay Council, Strathfield Municipal Council, None for Sutherland)
break_it.what_happens: exact ILIKE never matched the bare table lga, so the permitted set was empty and every lot silently fell to dwelling_house
break_it.how: _norm_lga drops council-type words so the suffixed name matches; test_realistic_forms_r4_lifts_to_residential_flat asserts the lift, and the 25 table LGAs were verified to normalise to distinct keys

break_it.scenario: An LGA outside the 25-LGA table is requested
break_it.what_happens: no permitted rows match -> a denser form could be wrongly assumed, or a crash on empty data
break_it.how: empty permitted set -> _ceiling_within_tier returns dwelling_house; floor and ceiling both dwelling_house (conservative). test_realistic_forms_unonboarded_lga_is_conservative

break_it.scenario: The lep_land_use_table query raises (DB down / timeout)
break_it.what_happens: an unhandled error would break the whole brief, or a partial result could over-report
break_it.how: _permitted_engine_forms catches all exceptions and returns an empty set -> conservative dwelling_house. test_realistic_forms_failsafe_on_db_error

break_it.scenario: Existing consumers of realistic_dwellings get a surprise number after the restructure
break_it.what_happens: if realistic_dwellings flipped to the ceiling, downstream/UI would suddenly show a non-conservative figure
break_it.how: realistic_dwellings still follows the primary dev_type (the floor) and stays 1; the upside lives in max_permitted_dwellings. test_range_floor_is_conservative_ceiling_is_the_upside + 295 related tests pass

post_merge.manual_verify: Re-run a brief for an R3 lot (14 Stanley St, Concord = floor 1 / ceiling 3 multi_dwelling) and an R2 lot (17 Corden Ave, Five Dock = floor 1 / ceiling 2 dual_occupancy) and confirm the ceiling is capped at the zone tier (no shop_top/RFB on R2/R3) and realistic_dwellings stays conservative. Next increment: render the range on the capacity card (as-of-right -> subject-to-DA) before exposure; refinement #1 = Housing-SEPP/LMR as-of-right floor uplift + catchment.
